member.name: M:LegalEngine.Rules.RuleEngine.formatDocument(LegalEngine.Domain.DocumentMetadata,LegalEngine.Domain.Ruleset,Microsoft.FSharp.Core.FSharpOption{System.Int32},Microsoft.FSharp.Core.FSharpOption{System.String},System.Boolean,LegalEngine.Domain.LegalDocument)
member.summary:
Run the full formatting pipeline on a document.
Steps: 1. Validate sections against ruleset 2. Reorder sections to canonical order 3. Insert stubs for missing required sections (optional) 4. Normalize headings 5. Generate caption from metadata 6. Generate signature block and certifications 7. Check formatting compliance
Returns the formatted document and all validation findings.
